mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery TD5 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Land Rover Discovery TD5 engine typically costs between £2,500 and £4,000 for supply only [THIRD-PARTY]. Used runner units start from around £800. Reconditioned units range from £1,500 to £2,500. Prices vary based on the specific TD5 10P or 15P engine code and inclusion of steel dowel upgrades.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of head gasket failure in a Discovery TD5?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs of the plastic dowel head gasket failure include unexplained coolant loss without visible external leaks. Mayonnaise-like sludge under the oil filler cap. White exhaust smoke under heavy load or during cold starts. Overheating during slow off-road or towing work.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a classic Land Rover Discovery TD5?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for well-maintained examples. The Land Rover Discovery TD5 is a highly capable classic 4x4 with current market values ranging from £2,500 to over £7,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a sensible fraction of the vehicle's total value if the chassis is solid. It preserves the car's heritage, heavy-duty towing capability, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units eliminate the factory plastic dowel flaw permanently.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the TD5 10P and 15P engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The TD5 10P (1998-2002) is the original version of the 2.5L inline-five diesel. The TD5 15P (2002-2004) introduced revised engine management, an updated sealed injector harness to prevent ECU oil contamination, and factory-fitted steel locating dowels to prevent head gasket failure. Both share the same robust bottom end and benefit equally from reliability upgrades.

mainEntity.name: Do rebuilt TD5 engines include the steel dowel and injector loom upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, any reputable specialist rebuilding a Land Rover Discovery TD5 engine will machine the block to accept aftermarket steel locating dowels and fit an updated, sealed injector harness. This entirely eliminates the plastic dowel deformation and ECU oil contamination issues. It ensures the cylinder head remains perfectly aligned under heavy towing loads. These upgrades are considered mandatory for any long-term TD5 build.

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery TD5 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched in 1998, the Land Rover Discovery TD5 (Series II) replaced the rugged 200Tdi with a more refined, electronically controlled 2.5-litre inline-five diesel, offering improved emissions and drivability while retaining legendary off-road capability.

milestones.description: TD5 10P (2.5L Diesel), 122hp, launched in the Discovery Series II, featuring electronic injection and improved refinement over the outgoing 200Tdi.
TD5 15P (2.5L Diesel), 122hp, introduced with revised engine management, an updated injector harness (to prevent oil migration to the ECU), and steel locating dowels to prevent head gasket failure.

commonProblems.h2: Land Rover Discovery TD5 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The 2.5L TD5 in the Land Rover Discovery TD5 is a robust, torque-rich workhorse. However, two well-documented factory flaws require attention: injector loom oil leaks and plastic head gasket dowels. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.group: Head Gasket Failure & Plastic Dowel Weakness
problems.h4: Head Gasket Failure & Plastic Dowel Weakness - Why the Land Rover Discovery TD5 Requires Upgrades
problems.rootCause: Land Rover originally used plastic locating dowels to align the cylinder head. Over time and repeated heat cycles, these plastic dowels deform and collapse, allowing the head to shift slightly under combustion pressures, which inevitably blows the head gasket.

repairOptions.tier: Preventative Head Gasket & Steel Dowel Upgrade
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Head removal, skim, new gasket, and mandatory fitment of aftermarket steel locating dowels
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable if the block and head are undamaged; the definitive fix

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt TD5 with steel dowels, upgraded head studs, and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has suffered hydro-lock, severe overheating, or bottom-end knock

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A classic Land Rover Discovery TD5 currently holds a UK market value of £2,500 to £7,000+ depending on condition, chassis rust, and originality [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost can represent a significant portion of the vehicle's value, making careful evaluation essential. If the lowest viable replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value, evaluate scrap value before committing.
problems.recommendation: If caught before catastrophic mixing of fluids, a specialist head gasket replacement paired with the mandatory steel dowel upgrade is the most cost-effective and permanent route. However, if the engine has been run with low coolant or exhibits bottom-end bearing knock, investing in a fully rebuilt unit is the safest way to guarantee the next 100,000 miles of reliability.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt TD5 10P Land Rover Discovery TD5 engine prices

problems.h4: Injector Loom Oil Leak - Land Rover Discovery TD5 ECU Contamination Vulnerability
problems.rootCause: The injector wiring harness seal degrades over time, allowing engine oil to wick up the loom via capillary action and pool inside the Engine Control Unit (ECU), causing catastrophic electrical failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement of the injector harness with an updated sealed loom, plus ECU cleaning or replacement
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable for preventing or fixing early-stage electrical faults

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with a pre-fitted upgraded loom and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary only if the engine has suffered secondary damage or the ECU is beyond repair

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Given the £2,500-£7,000+ value band of the Land Rover Discovery TD5, proactive loom replacement is trivial in comparison to the vehicle's worth and significantly improves daily drivability.
problems.recommendation: Proactive replacement of the injector loom with an updated, sealed harness is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If the ECU has already been destroyed by oil contamination, factor the ECU replacement cost into your overall repair or engine replacement budget.
